name: Smart clipboard & tracking scrubber
description: When you copy and paste links or text from modern web pages, social media platforms, or marketing emails, tracking entities secretly embed surveillance markers into your clipboard. These include UTM campaign tags, Facebook click IDs (fbclid), Google click IDs (gclid), affiliate tracking tokens, and invisible zero-width unicode characters (such as zero-width spaces U+200B and word joiners U+2060) that can fingerprint your specific user account across applications. PrivacyFold's Smart Clipboard & Tracking Scrubber sanitizes copied links and prose entirely in client-side memory. It strips surveillance parameters, normalizes obfuscated characters, and emits pristine, privacy-clean text with zero tracking leakage.

seo.aeoSummary: PrivacyFold's Smart Clipboard Scrubber cleans tracking parameters (UTM, fbclid, gclid, msclkid) and strips invisible zero-width steganographic characters from text and URLs entirely within client browser memory.

faqs.question: What are zero-width tracking characters and how do companies use them?
faqs.answer: Zero-width characters (such as U+200B Zero Width Space, U+200C Zero Width Non-Joiner, and U+FEFF Byte Order Mark) are invisible to the naked eye. Certain newsletters, corporate intranets, and social networks embed unique binary sequences of these characters into copied text to watermark which employee or user copied the text and track where it is shared.

faqs.question: Which URL tracking parameters does the scrubber automatically strip?
faqs.answer: The scrubber strips over 60 known tracking parameters including utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_term, utm_content, fbclid, gclid, msclkid, dclid, mc_eid, igshid, ref, source, and marketing session IDs.

faqs.question: Will cleaning the link break the website destination?
faqs.answer: No. Tracking parameters are analytics metadata appended to query strings. Stripping them leaves the core path and essential functional parameters (such as search queries or article IDs) completely intact.

faqs.question: Does PrivacyFold log or inspect the links I paste?
faqs.answer: No. All regex matching and string normalization occur directly inside your browser tab. Your links and text are never sent across the network or stored in any database.

faqs.question: Can I clean multi-line text containing multiple embedded links at once?
faqs.answer: Yes. The scrubber parses full multi-paragraph articles and documents, scrubbing all links and invisible characters throughout the entire passage in a single pass.

faqs.question: Can I integrate clipboard cleaning into an automated workflow?
faqs.answer: Yes. The `privacyfold.clean_paste` method is fully accessible via our JavaScript SDK and local MCP agent interface, making it easy to sanitize pasted content in headless automated pipelines.

faqs.question: Does the tool remove tracking redirects from shortened or affiliate links?
faqs.answer: The scrubber strips query parameters and unmasks standard UTM campaign wrappers. For nested redirect hops, the destination path is preserved while all marketing identifiers and affiliate cookies are scrubbed.

steps: Paste your copied URL or article snippet into the local text input area.
The scanner instantly highlights detected marketing trackers, referrer IDs, and invisible zero-width unicode characters.
Click "Scrub Tracking" to strip tracking tokens and clean the text.
Review the clean URL and verify that all original destinations remain intact.
Click "Copy Clean" to place the sanitized text back on your clipboard.
